## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
ROTATION — Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: cyclicals leading (Materials +3.10% 1W; Financials +1.96% 1W) and leadership is broad (Top 5 span 4 sectors), but major divergence among large caps (AAPL, UNH, TSLA) warrants tactical caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials also constructive: BA (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +20.67%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +5.62% | 1M: +9.77%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary soft: NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND; TGT (1W: -3.45% | 1M: +7.62%) CORRECTION. Consumer Staples/Utilities showing pressure: PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND; WMT (1W: -3.92% | 1M: +5.51%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, CHTR (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +1.12%) CORRECTION, PSA (1W: -3.01% | 1M: -2.68%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Consumer and Real Estate names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +7.37% | 1M: +26.43%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND; watch GILD (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -0.49%) RECOVERY as a tactical reversal candidate and note major multi-cap divergences.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech mixed but constructive: NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +3.12%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION — sector 1W +1.16% across 19 stocks, internal rotation present.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are a rotation beneficiary: JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +5.40% | 1M: +11.79%) ABOVE TREND — sector 1W +1.96% (20 stocks), supports Value/Cyclical tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed: MRK (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +8.37%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -0.49%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W +1.12% (15 stocks), idiosyncratic moves dominate.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure given rotation: materials and financials (FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +20.67%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to structurally weak Consumer names showing BELOW TREND (NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND) and monitor tech names for follow-through.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NKE (1W: -14.57% | 1M: -8.11%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -4.45% | 1M: -0.85%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +3.10% | 1M: +9.46%) and Financials (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +10.76%) — breadth supportive of rotation. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.84% | 1M: +5.95%) and Consumer Staples (1W: -0.80% | 1M: +0.50%) — watch for further downside differentiation.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND — watch near prior resistance for continuation. AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION — monitor support for trend validation. JPM (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +9.37%) ABOVE TREND — breakout level watch for financial-led continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TSLA (+45): TSLA (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +24.16%) CORRECTION — bullish price-target upgrades but 1W weakness suggests short-term profit-taking/divergence to monitor. (Sentiment confirms longer-term momentum but short-term distribution.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PFE (-75): PFE (1W: -2.55% | 1M: -0.64%) BELOW TREND — severe negative headline and price weakness are aligned. META (-50): META (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +11.99%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price strength = divergence to watch for accumulation or headline-driven volatility; UNH (-45): UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION — negative headlines confirming near-term pullback.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with a Value/Cyclical style tilt (Materials and Financials favored). FCX (1W: +9.17% | 1M: +30.17%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +7.30% | 1M: +20.97%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +6.47% | 1M: +5.78%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps (AAPL (1W: -0.82% | 1M: +0.32%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -2.81% | 1M: +2.19%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +24.16%) CORRECTION) and concentrated news hits (PFE -75) that could prompt tactical volatility.
